●	Installed and configured Access Control Software on customer servers
●	Troubleshot server networking and hardware issues for client’s job site

positions.title: Programmer, Global Systems
positions.description:
Utilizing a high level of proficiency in all aspects of multiple card access, and video enterprise systems, and on a largely self-directed basis, program and configure new installations to include access areas, micro/panel information IP address/backup IP, badging categories, schedules (ranges from <5 readers to >105).
Utilizing a high level of proficiency in all aspects of multiple card access, and video enterprise systems, and on a largely self-directed basis, program new hardware at new and existing sites. Program and configuration to include access areas, micro/panel information IP address/backup IP, badging categories, schedules (ranges from <5 readers to >105).
Perform acceptance testing for all hardwire installations globally (requires working on off hour to support local international time zones).
Troubleshooting system software issues and perform regular system updates, patches and health checks.
Directly interface with client security officers and key members of the global support team to assist in managing global customer enterprise systems as well as participate on system design and support conference calls.

positions.title: Technical Support/Jr. Developer
positions.description:

●	Customized software functionality using VBScript 
●	Search through and add customer data in MS SQL Server 2005/2008
●	Maintained business relationships with various clients by offering technical support and scheduled maintenance
●	Performed QA testing for software updates using VMware products
positions.insights: Skills: Collaborative Problem Solving · Automation · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Information Technology · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I provide research computer programming support to the Center for Advanced Public Safety (CAPS) within the Department of Computer Science at the University of Alabama. My responsibilities include: Maintain existing software systems and programs. This involves writing code to correct bugs (errors) in the code, upgrading software and systems as new technologies come out and making changes in the code to accommodate functionality changes requested by our software users and by our sponsors.
Plan, design, develop, and program (write code for) new software programs.
I posses knowledge of intermediate programming, networking, system, multimedia or instructional technology skills.
positions.insights: Skills: Collaborative Problem Solving · Automation · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Information Technology · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
